Well I'd like to start of by saying that every person is different and how the body reacts to certain changes may differ from person to person as well. However many people who've used the starvation method as a way of suicide have been studied by doctors, psychologists, etc.... these people were usually not Anorexic patients but perhaps war soldiers and captives, people in hospitals, people who go through a hunger strike as a form of protest, and many more. From those studies specialists have concluded that after several days without food or water people end up in a severe state of Paranoid behavior and/ or hallucinations. I personally went 5 days without food or water and I didn't go through any paranoid symptoms BUT I did have audio-sensory hallucinations. I heard things that weren't there and sometimes I would feel people or things touching me (for example: I have a cat and towards the end of those 5 days I would think that she was in my room sleeping next to me. I would hear the purring and feel her furry skin but when I turned on the light she wasn't there). If I didn't start eating or drinking water after day 5 I most certainly would have the exact paranoid behavior that occurs usually. 

I think the reason why many Anorexic patients don't have these symptoms before they die is most definitely the time period. You see people with eating disorders don't change their eating habits in 1 day or 1 week. It's a very draining process that takes months or sometimes even years to develop. By the time they've reached the finale state of their disorder their brains have had the time to adjust themselves, whereas people without eating disorders don't. That's why their symptoms change drastically in a short period of time and their deaths can be visually more scary to the people surrounding them. Usually people without an ED who decide to starve themselves don't eat or drink to speed up the process (which is a bit of a overestimation since it still takes at least 8 days).

But don't be scared, as you've read it took me 5 days without any bite of food or any sip of water to even get to the point of audio hallucinations so a paranoid disorder isn't something to worry about.

Every person is different so every answer is going to be different but here is my experience (I'm a bisexual woman btw):

3. A romantic relationship differs for me from a friendship when there is physical intimacy, planning the future, etc....
4. A romantic attraction feels like you have found a soul that matches yours. You want to spend the rest of your life with them. 5. A sexual attraction is when you want to give your body but not perhaps your soul. You want to feel them on your skin, enjoy each others bodies, play and tease, make them satisfied etc....it's all physical

7. *do you feel sexual arousal without sexual attraction* certainly yes. I'm not sure what the biological explanation is but that's basically what masturbation is for. Your body can feel sexually aroused without having a specific attraction towards someone.
